image_description: A beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) placed diagonally across the screen and click wheel of a silver iPod-like MP3 player. The bandage has a central pad and adhesive backing. The device has a black screen and a circular control interface. There is a watermark 'jupiterimages' at the bottom.
